name: soil settlement
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学

complete_examples.text: The effects of interfacial damage of the track slab induced by soil settlement on the dynamic interaction system are considered.
The soil settlement-induced track deformation is calculated by a practical iteration algorithm, where the nonlinear interfacial damage is simulated by the cohesive zone model.

P078.title: Modelling and analysis of train-track-subgrade-soil dynamic interaction subjected to the interfacial damage of slab induced by uneven settlement
P078.authors: W Wang, Z Li, L Xu, X Wei
